title.en: Salesforce and NVIDIA announce Koa, a CRM reasoning model built on Nemotron
title.zhHans: Salesforce 与英伟达联合发布基于 Nemotron 的 CRM 推理模型 Koa

searchSummary.en: On September 15, 2026, Salesforce announced Koa, a CRM reasoning model post-trained from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on synthetic CRM scenarios. Salesforce said Koa was in internal use and available to six named pilot customers; general availability was expected in winter 2026. Pilot participation is not treated as production adoption.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 9 月 15 日，Salesforce 宣布 Koa，这是一款基于 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super、使用合成 CRM 场景进行后训练的 CRM 推理模型。Salesforce 表示 Koa 已在内部使用，并向六家具名客户提供试点；全面开放预计在 2026 年冬季。客户试点不按生产采用处理。

summary.en: On September 15, 2026, Salesforce announced Koa, a CRM reasoning model post-trained from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on synthetic CRM scenarios. Salesforce said Koa was in internal use and available to six named pilot customers; general availability was expected in winter 2026. Pilot participation is not treated as production adoption.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 9 月 15 日，Salesforce 宣布 Koa，这是一款基于 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super、使用合成 CRM 场景进行后训练的 CRM 推理模型。Salesforce 表示 Koa 已在内部使用，并向六家具名客户提供试点；全面开放预计在 2026 年冬季。客户试点不按生产采用处理。

narrative.en: Salesforce post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on synthetic CRM scenarios and runs Koa within its own infrastructure. The company reports internal use and six named customer pilots. Its CRM benchmark and performance statements remain vendor-led, and general availability was still planned. Separate Missionforce statements about post-trained NVIDIA models are not treated as Koa deployment evidence.
narrative.zhHans: Salesforce 使用合成 CRM 场景对 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 进行后训练，并在自有基础设施内运行 Koa。公司报告了内部使用和六家具名客户试点。CRM 基准和性能数据仍由厂商主导，全面开放尚处于计划阶段。有关 Missionforce 采用后训练 NVIDIA 模型的单独表述，不作为 Koa 部署证据。

text.en: Salesforce announced Koa and made it available to six named pilot customers in Agentforce, with general availability expected later.
text.zhHans: Salesforce 宣布 Koa，并通过 Agentforce 向六家具名客户提供试点，全面开放时间仍在之后。

text.en: Six unaffiliated customers gained immediate pilot access to Koa for CRM workflow testing.
text.zhHans: 六家无关联客户即时获得 Koa 的 CRM 工作流试点资格。

text.en: Customer pilots do not establish production deployment, and the reported benchmark was not independently run.
text.zhHans: 客户试点不能证明生产部署，相关基准也不是独立运行的评测。

description.en: Six named businesses gained pilot access to the model in Agentforce.
description.zhHans: 六家具名企业获得了通过 Agentforce 试用该模型的资格。
